name: SpongeBob SquarePants: Lost In Time - Dunces and Dragons
summary: Based on the "Dunces and Dragons" episode, the game revolves around SpongeBob and Patrick being transported to a medieval Bikini Bottom after a jousting accident. Players (as SpongeBob, Patrick, Sandy, or Squidward) navigate platforming levels to rescue Princess Pearl from the evil wizard Planktonamor and his dragon.
